# Third-party Singular library

`finvar.lib` is preserved byte for byte from the project's pinned copy:
version 4.3.1.3, February2023. Its header identifies Agnes E. Heydtmann and
Simon A. King as authors; the original notices remain in the source.

The upstream Singular COPYING notice permits GNU GPLversion 2 or version 3.
This directory includes the upstream notice and the complete GPLversion 2 text.
The vendor code is distributed under those terms. A repository license for
original code does not override them. No modification to finvar.lib was made.

`COPYING.Singular` is the current upstream project notice retrieved 2026-09-29,
not a claim that the pinned library was produced in 2026. Exact source URLs and
hashes are in `license_sources.json`.
